introHtml: Stainless steel golf divot tools offer a refined look and lasting durability that plastic or aluminum alternatives simply can't match. The weight and feel of a stainless steel tool signals quality to every golfer who receives it. Whether you are planning a corporate outing or a sales incentive program, these tools accept crisp laser engraving or screen printing on the handle. The Flip Divot Tool & Marker combines a sleek stainless steel body with a convenient ball marker, making it a practical giveaway that your recipients will actually carry in their pocket round after round.
